new_diseases.name: Bullous pemphigoid
new_diseases.diagnostic_discriminator: Tense pruritic bullae; subepidermal split with eosinophils and linear basement membrane IgG/C3.

new_diseases.name: Pemphigus vulgaris
new_diseases.diagnostic_discriminator: Flaccid blisters, oral erosions, suprabasal acantholysis; intercellular IgG.

new_diseases.name: Pemphigus foliaceus
new_diseases.diagnostic_discriminator: Superficial subcorneal acantholysis; desmoglein-1, mucosal sparing.

new_diseases.name: Dermatitis herpetiformis
new_diseases.diagnostic_discriminator: Pruritic extensor papulovesicles; granular papillary IgA; gluten-sensitive enteropathy.

new_diseases.name: Linear IgA bullous dermatosis
new_diseases.diagnostic_discriminator: Linear IgA deposition along basement membrane; vancomycin association.

new_diseases.name: Epidermolysis bullosa acquisita
new_diseases.diagnostic_discriminator: Type VII collagen autoantibodies; floor-side salt split; trauma-induced scarring.

new_diseases.name: Lichen planus
new_diseases.diagnostic_discriminator: Pruritic purple planar papules; lichenoid interface dermatitis.

new_diseases.name: Hidradenitis suppurativa
new_diseases.diagnostic_discriminator: Follicular occlusion with recurrent nodules, abscesses and sinus tunnels; inflammatory systemic treatment for severe disease.

new_diseases.name: Rosacea
new_diseases.diagnostic_discriminator: Central facial flushing, telangiectasia and papules without comedones; ocular risks.

new_diseases.name: Vitiligo
new_diseases.diagnostic_discriminator: Depigmented patches from melanocyte loss; wood-lamp enhancement and possible immune associations.

new_diseases.name: Alopecia areata
new_diseases.diagnostic_discriminator: Nonscarring patchy autoimmune hair loss; preserved follicles and peribulbar lymphocytes.

new_diseases.name: Cutaneous small-vessel leukocytoclastic vasculitis
new_diseases.diagnostic_discriminator: Palpable purpura, neutrophilic vessel-wall injury; assess renal/other systemic involvement.

new_diseases.name: Pyoderma gangrenosum
new_diseases.diagnostic_discriminator: Painful undermined ulcers and pathergy; exclude infection, avoid indiscriminate debridement.

new_diseases.name: Stevens–Johnson syndrome / toxic epidermal necrolysis spectrum
new_diseases.diagnostic_discriminator: Mucocutaneous drug reaction with epidermal necrosis/detachment; immediate culprit drug withdrawal and specialized care.

new_diseases.name: Mycosis fungoides
new_diseases.diagnostic_discriminator: Epidermotropic cutaneous T-cell lymphoma with patch-plaque-tumor stages and often serial biopsies.

new_diseases.name: Sézary syndrome
new_diseases.diagnostic_discriminator: Leukemic cutaneous T-cell lymphoma: erythroderma and clonal abnormal blood T-cell population.

new_diseases.name: Merkel cell carcinoma
new_diseases.diagnostic_discriminator: Aggressive cutaneous neuroendocrine tumor; CK20 perinuclear-dot IHC in many tumors.

new_diseases.name: Dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans
new_diseases.diagnostic_discriminator: CD34+ storiform spindle tumor with honeycomb subcutaneous invasion; complete margins crucial.

new_diseases.name: Kaposi sarcoma
new_diseases.diagnostic_discriminator: HHV8-associated vascular spindle tumor with slitlike channels and HHV8 LANA IHC.

new_diseases.name: Pityriasis rosea
new_diseases.diagnostic_discriminator: Herald patch then oval collarette-scaled eruption along cleavage lines; consider syphilis differential.
